name: Brime de Sog (Spain)
description: Vertically divided red and green with a broader red hoist, the green charged with ten yellow discs arranged as a bunch of grapes.
history: Municipal flag of Brime de Sog; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: ten discs arranged as an inverted triangle, like a bunch of grapes
